t: Azure Épure is where I started — and a year later it is still the one I reach for. Fresh, elegant, quietly expensive.
Oud Serein is the calmest oud I have ever worn: woody depth, no harshness. It lasts from morning meetings to midnight.
Ambre Velours feels like velvet on a winter evening — sweet, but never childish. My signature for three months now.
I began with the discovery set and finished with all three flacons. Azure Épure by day, Ambre Velours by night.
